title: Part Time REMOTE Analytics Coordinator 158968
description:
MUST be a WI resident or willing to relocate to WI prior to starting the role at their own expense.

Position Summary

We are seeking a skilled and collaborative Analytics Coordinator to support the development and expansion of a data-driven digital analytics strategy. This part-time contract role will focus on creating custom analytics reports and dashboards, delivering trainings to stakeholders, and helping teams better understand website traffic, engagement trends, and digital performance metrics. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with Google Analytics, reporting tools, and presenting complex data in a clear and actionable way for non-technical users.

Qualifications

  • 2–3 years of experience working with Google Analytics required
  • Experience creating custom analytics reports and dashboards required
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly PowerPoint
  • Experience developing and leading engaging trainings or workshops required
  • Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects in a remote environment
  • Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills with the ability to work across teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using Looker Studio for reporting and dashboard creation preferred
  • Understanding of HTML, UI/UX principles, and basic website design preferred
  • Familiarity with web accessibility standards preferred
  • Experience translating technical analytics concepts for non-technical audiences preferred

title: Licensed Practical Nurse 11036
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a compassionate and dependable Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) to provide direct patient care within a structured healthcare environment. This role is responsible for administering nursing care within scope of practice, monitoring patient conditions, maintaining accurate medical documentation, and supporting interdisciplinary healthcare teams to ensure quality patient outcomes.

Qualifications

  • Active Ohio Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license required
  • Current BLS/CPR certification required
  • Strong knowledge of nursing procedures, pharmacology, patient care practices, and HIPAA standards
  • Ability to work effectively within a team-oriented healthcare environment
  • Strong documentation, communication, and critical thinking skills
  • Ability to respond calmly and appropriately in emergency situations

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in correctional, behavioral health, long-term care, or institutional healthcare settings preferred
  • Experience with medication administration and electronic medical records preferred

title: Employer Advocate 158261
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused professional to support retirement and pension benefit operations within a collaborative office environment. This role is responsible for reviewing and processing employer-submitted documentation, maintaining accurate member account information, supporting benefit-related transactions, and assisting with customer inquiries. The ideal candidate will possess strong communication skills, administrative experience, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting.

Qualifications

  • Associate degree with at least one year of customer service experience required; OR High School diploma/GED with a minimum of three years of customer service experience required
  • Previous experience in financial services, insurance, employee benefits, retirement services, pension administration, or related industries preferred
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Outlook
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a structured office environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a team-oriented environment

Preferred Skills

  • Experience processing records, account updates, or benefit-related transactions preferred
  • Experience working with databases, reporting tools, or tracking systems preferred
  • Strong problem-solving and customer service skills preferred
